MZ report

HubSpot CRM — Contact sync
Pulls all contacts from your HubSpot CRM (including Calendly bookings, form fills, email inquiries) and maps them to your funnel. Requires a Private App token with Contacts (read) scope — create one at HubSpot Settings → Integrations → Private Apps.
Data — Export / Import
Use this to move your data between file:// and localhost, or to back up everything. Export on one, import on the other.
Save to file embeds all your data into a new HTML — works on file:// and localhost identically. Use this after any major sync or data change.
Settings
API key and preferences
App build v — if this doesn't match the version you deployed, the update didn't apply.
Anthropic API key
Required for AI brief generation. Get yours at console.anthropic.com. Stored locally only.
Asana sync
One Asana project per channel (e.g. Kasun's video board, Javeria's SEO board). The OS is the source of truth for stage — pushing a task moves its card to the matching column. Asana never moves a card back. New tasks created directly in Asana still get pulled in. Create a token at app.asana.com/0/my-apps. Stored locally only.
Assignee mapping
Map each team member to their Asana user GID so tasks are assigned automatically when pushed. Get GIDs from your Asana workspace URL when viewing a member's profile, or via the Asana API.
Add / edit a channel mapping

HubSpot sync
Two-way sync: updates every lead's live stage/status/record link by email, and automatically pulls in new HubSpot contacts (training program excluded). With a token saved, it runs by itself — on opening Outreach and every 30 min while the app is open (when the last sync is 4+ hours old). Needs a Private App token with the crm.objects.contacts.read scope.

Email & call templates
Intro email — same day as 1st call
Follow-up email — with 2nd call (day 3–4)
Call script — all 3 calls (live + voicemail)
Final email — break-up, after 3rd call (day 7–8)
Cadence: Day 1 — call + intro email · Day 3–4 — call + follow-up · Day 7–8 — final call + break-up. Placeholders {{FirstName}} and {{Company}} — replace before sending. Edits save automatically.
